correctness.rationale: Complete Gaussian-Hermite angular decomposition; exact elementary radial integration yields 2-by-2 blocks and skew commutator. Direct eigenanalysis proves full singular spectrum, Schatten membership and finite-mode staircase for all x,y>0. The unique branch maximum follows by solving the two stationary equations and boundary decay; the strict Robbins Stirling remainder and explicit cubic logarithm bound prove each maximum below 1/(pi sqrt(2e)), while Stirling asymptotics prove sharpness. The included executable independently verified 2778 finite symbolic, quadrature, spectral and hypergeometric assertions; the infinite conclusion uses the analytical proof.

value.rationale: The first full two-level Gaussian Fock concentration problem is noncommutative despite concentric nested symbols, whereas the analytic true levels commute. The theorem characterizes the complete compact commutator singular spectrum and Schatten profile, discovers exact mode-switch thresholds indexed by angular momentum, and solves the sharp all-radii norm problem with nonattainment and explicit asymptotic witnesses. These are geometrically and operator-theoretically meaningful quantities, not arbitrary tabulation or marginal improvements.
